title: 潛盾掘進導向控制~TBM alignment guidance and control
focus: 把坐標基準、機身姿態與環片幾何連成可獨立查核的導航鏈~Link coordinate datum, machine attitude and ring geometry in an independently checkable navigation chain
summary: 本課聚焦把坐標基準、機身姿態與環片幾何連成可獨立查核的導航鏈。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on link coordinate datum, machine attitude and ring geometry in an independently checkable navigation chain. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 控制網與坐標基準~Control networks and coordinate datum
units.title: 控制網與坐標基準~Control networks and coordinate datum
units.mechanism: 隧道導航從地表控制延伸到洞內測站再到機器目標，任何基準轉換錯誤都會沿鏈傳遞。坐標系、軸向、單位及高程需在同一版本，畫面上的小偏差只有在基準正確時才有意義。 假設本地點距轉換原點1000 m，尺度錯誤10 ppm產生10 mm位置差；非儀器隨機誤差。 原點吻合但尺度或旋轉錯誤可在長距離逐步放大，施工前段看似正常後段才偏離；若更換坐標版本未通知設備端，導航顯示會產生假跳動。~Navigation transfers surface control through underground stations to machine targets, propagating datum errors along the chain. Coordinate frame, axes, units and elevation must share a version; small displayed offsets matter only within the correct datum. At an assumed distance 1000 m from a transformation origin, a 10 ppm scale error creates 10 mm position error, not random instrument noise. A matching origin with wrong scale or rotation diverges over distance, appearing normal early and failing later. An uncommunicated datum revision can also create a false jump on the navigation display.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設本地點距轉換原點1000 m，尺度錯誤10 ppm產生10 mm位置差；非儀器隨機誤差。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At an assumed distance 1000 m from a transformation origin, a 10 ppm scale error creates 10 mm position error, not random instrument noise.
units.verify: 以獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換、尺度和高程，保存轉換矩陣與版本；測量主管須確認設計線形、機器與竣工資料使用同一基準，不能只比對某一重合原點。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：原點吻合但尺度或旋轉錯誤可在長距離逐步放大，施工前段看似正常後段才偏離；若更換坐標版本未通知設備端，導航顯示會產生假跳動。~Check transformations, scale and elevation at independent controls and retain matrices and versions; the survey lead confirms a common datum for design alignment, machine and as-built data rather than checking one coincident origin alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A matching origin with wrong scale or rotation diverges over distance, appearing normal early and failing later. An uncommunicated datum revision can also create a false jump on the navigation display.
units.failure: 原點吻合但尺度或旋轉錯誤可在長距離逐步放大，施工前段看似正常後段才偏離；若更換坐標版本未通知設備端，導航顯示會產生假跳動。~A matching origin with wrong scale or rotation diverges over distance, appearing normal early and failing later. An uncommunicated datum revision can also create a false jump on the navigation display.
units.misconception: 坐標原點重合就保證整條長隧道的尺度與旋轉都正確。~Coincident coordinate origins guarantee correct scale and rotation along the entire long tunnel.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄控制網與坐標基準的資料來源與適用條件。以獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換、尺度和高程，保存轉換矩陣與版本；測量主管須確認設計線形、機器與竣工資料使用同一基準，不能只比對某一重合原點。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for control networks and coordinate datum. Check transformations, scale and elevation at independent controls and retain matrices and versions; the survey lead confirms a common datum for design alignment, machine and as-built data rather than checking one coincident origin alone.

units.anchor: 方位精度與遠距傳遞~Azimuth precision over distance
units.title: 方位精度與遠距傳遞~Azimuth precision over distance
units.mechanism: 長隧道方向誤差會隨距離放大，角度精度與位置精度必須分別規劃。多次測站轉接可能累積相關偏差，單次儀器精度不能直接當作全線貫通精度，需用網平差和獨立方向控制。 假設視距300 m、角度誤差1.5 arcsec，側向尺度300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm；未含設站誤差。 對中誤差或折射若總朝同一側會形成系統曲線偏差，增加相同幾何的測次未必改善；忽略共同偏差可能得到過度樂觀的貫通估計。~Angular error grows into lateral position error along a long tunnel. Repeated station transfers can accumulate correlated bias, so one instrument rating is not a breakthrough-accuracy estimate; network adjustment and independent orientation are required. Assume sight distance 300 m and angular error 1.5 arcsec; lateral scale is 300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm, excluding station error. Consistently directed centering or refraction creates systematic alignment drift that repeating identical geometry may not reduce. Ignoring common bias produces an overly optimistic estimate of eventual breakthrough accuracy.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設視距300 m、角度誤差1.5 arcsec，側向尺度300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm；未含設站誤差。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume sight distance 300 m and angular error 1.5 arcsec; lateral scale is 300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm, excluding station error.
units.verify: 以正倒鏡、多測回及獨立方向基準核對方位，將設站、對中與角度不確定分項傳播；測量工程師應檢查相關性，不能把每測段誤差都當互相抵消。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：對中誤差或折射若總朝同一側會形成系統曲線偏差，增加相同幾何的測次未必改善；忽略共同偏差可能得到過度樂觀的貫通估計。~Check azimuth with face reversals, repeated sets and independent direction references, propagating station, centering and angular uncertainties separately; survey engineers assess correlation rather than assuming segment errors cancel each other. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Consistently directed centering or refraction creates systematic alignment drift that repeating identical geometry may not reduce. Ignoring common bias produces an overly optimistic estimate of eventual breakthrough accuracy.
units.failure: 對中誤差或折射若總朝同一側會形成系統曲線偏差，增加相同幾何的測次未必改善；忽略共同偏差可能得到過度樂觀的貫通估計。~Consistently directed centering or refraction creates systematic alignment drift that repeating identical geometry may not reduce. Ignoring common bias produces an overly optimistic estimate of eventual breakthrough accuracy.
units.misconception: 每一測段的角度誤差必定獨立而且可以互相抵消。~Angular errors in every survey segment are necessarily independent and cancel each other.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄方位精度與遠距傳遞的資料來源與適用條件。以正倒鏡、多測回及獨立方向基準核對方位，將設站、對中與角度不確定分項傳播；測量工程師應檢查相關性，不能把每測段誤差都當互相抵消。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for azimuth precision over distance. Check azimuth with face reversals, repeated sets and independent direction references, propagating station, centering and angular uncertainties separately; survey engineers assess correlation rather than assuming segment errors cancel each other.

units.anchor: 陀螺定向與漂移~Gyro orientation and drift
units.title: 陀螺定向與漂移~Gyro orientation and drift
units.mechanism: 陀螺提供不依賴長視線的方向資訊，但仍需校準、溫度與時間穩定性檢查。它不是自動真值，應與光學控制形成獨立比較，並辨識兩者是否共享同一坐標轉換偏差。 假設方向偏差0.001 rad，在100 m投影造成約100 mm側移；小角近似e=Lθ。 校準基線若本身錯誤，陀螺和後續資料可能一致卻共同偏轉；未保存漂移歷程又會把溫度效應誤判成機器實際轉向。~Gyro orientation avoids dependence on a long sight line but still requires calibration and thermal and temporal checks. It is not automatic truth; compare it independently with optical control while identifying any shared datum bias. Assume direction bias 0.001 rad; projection over 100 m gives approximately 100 mm lateral error through e=Lθ. A faulty calibration baseline makes subsequent gyro observations consistently wrong, while missing drift history allows thermal effects to masquerade as actual steering. Agreement within that shared chain does not establish correctness.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設方向偏差0.001 rad，在100 m投影造成約100 mm側移；小角近似e=Lθ。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume direction bias 0.001 rad; projection over 100 m gives approximately 100 mm lateral error through e=Lθ.
units.verify: 在已知方位基線做前後校驗，保留儀器溫度、觀測時間與漂移修正；比較陀螺和光學差值隨時間變化，超出核准不確定範圍時先查量測鏈，不自行選較順眼結果。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：校準基線若本身錯誤，陀螺和後續資料可能一致卻共同偏轉；未保存漂移歷程又會把溫度效應誤判成機器實際轉向。~Calibrate before and after on a known azimuth and retain temperature, time and drift corrections; track gyro-optical disagreement and investigate the chain outside approved uncertainty rather than selecting the more convenient result. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A faulty calibration baseline makes subsequent gyro observations consistently wrong, while missing drift history allows thermal effects to masquerade as actual steering. Agreement within that shared chain does not establish correctness.
units.failure: 校準基線若本身錯誤，陀螺和後續資料可能一致卻共同偏轉；未保存漂移歷程又會把溫度效應誤判成機器實際轉向。~A faulty calibration baseline makes subsequent gyro observations consistently wrong, while missing drift history allows thermal effects to masquerade as actual steering. Agreement within that shared chain does not establish correctness.
units.misconception: 陀螺方向是自動真值，不需再校準或考慮溫度漂移。~Gyro orientation is automatic truth needing no calibration or thermal-drift consideration.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄陀螺定向與漂移的資料來源與適用條件。在已知方位基線做前後校驗，保留儀器溫度、觀測時間與漂移修正；比較陀螺和光學差值隨時間變化，超出核准不確定範圍時先查量測鏈，不自行選較順眼結果。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for gyro orientation and drift. Calibrate before and after on a known azimuth and retain temperature, time and drift corrections; track gyro-optical disagreement and investigate the chain outside approved uncertainty rather than selecting the more convenient result.

units.anchor: 目標桿臂與機身姿態~Target lever arms and machine attitude
units.title: 目標桿臂與機身姿態~Target lever arms and machine attitude
units.mechanism: 導航量到的是目標點，再透過機身幾何換算刀盤中心與軸線。俯仰、偏航與滾轉都會影響桿臂投影，目標安裝後移位或模型版本錯誤，即使測量本身準確也會顯示錯誤機位。 假設目標距刀盤中心10 m、偏航0.1°，橫向桿臂修正10sin0.1°=17.45 mm；非可忽略常數。 只做平移而漏掉旋轉會使長桿臂偏差放大，目標支架鬆動又可能被控制系統當成機器偏離；追逐錯誤導航訊號會造成真實線形修正過度。~Navigation observes targets and transforms them through machine geometry to the cutterhead and axis. Pitch, yaw and roll alter lever-arm projection; a moved target or wrong geometry version creates incorrect machine position despite accurate measurement. Assume target-to-cutterhead lever arm 10 m and yaw 0.1°; lateral correction is 10sin0.1°=17.45 mm, not a negligible constant. Applying translation without rotation amplifies long-lever errors, while a loose target bracket can mimic machine deviation. Steering in response to that false signal creates real overcorrection of the alignment.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設目標距刀盤中心10 m、偏航0.1°，橫向桿臂修正10sin0.1°=17.45 mm；非可忽略常數。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume target-to-cutterhead lever arm 10 m and yaw 0.1°; lateral correction is 10sin0.1°=17.45 mm, not a negligible constant.
units.verify: 以獨立機身基準量測目標位置，核對三維旋轉順序與單位，維修後重新查驗；將顯示刀盤坐標與外部測量比較，設備和測量主管共同確認幾何模型版本。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只做平移而漏掉旋轉會使長桿臂偏差放大，目標支架鬆動又可能被控制系統當成機器偏離；追逐錯誤導航訊號會造成真實線形修正過度。~Independently survey target positions relative to machine references and check rotation order and units after maintenance; compare displayed cutterhead coordinates with external measurements and jointly approve geometry versions through equipment and survey leads. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Applying translation without rotation amplifies long-lever errors, while a loose target bracket can mimic machine deviation. Steering in response to that false signal creates real overcorrection of the alignment.
units.failure: 只做平移而漏掉旋轉會使長桿臂偏差放大，目標支架鬆動又可能被控制系統當成機器偏離；追逐錯誤導航訊號會造成真實線形修正過度。~Applying translation without rotation amplifies long-lever errors, while a loose target bracket can mimic machine deviation. Steering in response to that false signal creates real overcorrection of the alignment.
units.misconception: 從目標點算刀盤中心只需平移，不必考慮機身旋轉。~Transforming a target to cutterhead center requires translation only, without machine rotation.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄目標桿臂與機身姿態的資料來源與適用條件。以獨立機身基準量測目標位置，核對三維旋轉順序與單位，維修後重新查驗；將顯示刀盤坐標與外部測量比較，設備和測量主管共同確認幾何模型版本。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for target lever arms and machine attitude. Independently survey target positions relative to machine references and check rotation order and units after maintenance; compare displayed cutterhead coordinates with external measurements and jointly approve geometry versions through equipment and survey leads.

units.anchor: 設計線形與里程投影~Design alignment and chainage projection
units.title: 設計線形與里程投影~Design alignment and chainage projection
units.mechanism: 機器位置要投影到三維設計線形才能得到里程及橫縱偏差，曲線與縱坡使最近點不等同平面直線投影。線形版本和里程起算點需鎖定，否則各系統可能用不同名義位置討論同一環。 假設水平前進100 m、縱坡2%，高程變化2 m，斜長√(100²+2²)=100.020 m；里程定義須明示。 平面里程與斜距混用會逐步累積環號錯配，曲線左右符號用反又會顛倒修正方向；坐標數字合理仍不能保證工程定義一致。~Machine coordinates must project onto the three-dimensional design alignment to give chainage and offsets. Curvature and grade invalidate a simple planar projection, requiring a locked alignment version and station origin across systems. Assume 100 m horizontal advance on a 2% grade; elevation changes 2 m and slope length is 100.020 m, requiring an explicit chainage convention. Mixing horizontal chainage with slope distance progressively misassigns rings, while reversed left-right signs invert correction direction. Numerically plausible coordinates do not establish consistent engineering definitions across the workflow.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設水平前進100 m、縱坡2%，高程變化2 m，斜長√(100²+2²)=100.020 m；里程定義須明示。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 100 m horizontal advance on a 2% grade; elevation changes 2 m and slope length is 100.020 m, requiring an explicit chainage convention.
units.verify: 以已知曲線點和坡度點測試軟體投影，核對里程斷鏈與單位，將偏差向量畫在局部切線坐標；設計及測量團隊需共同核准線形更新，不能只交換沒有版本的坐標表。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：平面里程與斜距混用會逐步累積環號錯配，曲線左右符號用反又會顛倒修正方向；坐標數字合理仍不能保證工程定義一致。~Test software projection on known curve and grade points, checking station equations and units and plotting offsets in a local tangent frame; design and survey teams approve alignment revisions rather than exchanging unversioned coordinate tables. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mixing horizontal chainage with slope distance progressively misassigns rings, while reversed left-right signs invert correction direction. Numerically plausible coordinates do not establish consistent engineering definitions across the workflow.
units.failure: 平面里程與斜距混用會逐步累積環號錯配，曲線左右符號用反又會顛倒修正方向；坐標數字合理仍不能保證工程定義一致。~Mixing horizontal chainage with slope distance progressively misassigns rings, while reversed left-right signs invert correction direction. Numerically plausible coordinates do not establish consistent engineering definitions across the workflow.
units.misconception: 平面里程和斜距可以不加說明直接用在同一環號表。~Horizontal chainage and slope distance can be interchanged within one ring table without explanation.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄設計線形與里程投影的資料來源與適用條件。以已知曲線點和坡度點測試軟體投影，核對里程斷鏈與單位，將偏差向量畫在局部切線坐標；設計及測量團隊需共同核准線形更新，不能只交換沒有版本的坐標表。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for design alignment and chainage projection. Test software projection on known curve and grade points, checking station equations and units and plotting offsets in a local tangent frame; design and survey teams approve alignment revisions rather than exchanging unversioned coordinate tables.

units.anchor: 曲線組環與楔形量~Curved ring building and taper
units.title: 曲線組環與楔形量~Curved ring building and taper
units.mechanism: 楔形環片透過端面厚度差逐環改變軸線，旋轉組環可調整轉彎方向，但可達曲率受幾何與接縫限制。導航建議需和環片配置、尾隙及止水變形共同審查，不只是追逐中心線。 假設環寬1.5 m、曲率半徑300 m，每環轉角約L/R=0.005 rad=0.286°；為小角近似。 只求快速回到中心線可能使用過大曲率，造成接縫張開或尾刷偏壓；未記組環方向又使後續竣工線形無法對應到設計的幾何假設。~Tapered rings change axis direction through face-width differences, with ring rotation selecting direction. Achievable curvature depends on geometry and joints, requiring navigation choices to respect ring layout, tail clearance and gasket deformation rather than centerline alone. Assume ring width 1.5 m and curvature radius 300 m; turn per ring is approximately L/R=0.005 rad=0.286°, a small-angle approximation. Rapid centerline recovery can demand excessive curvature and produce joint opening or seal loading. Missing ring orientation records also prevent the as-built alignment from being reconciled with the assumed geometry.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設環寬1.5 m、曲率半徑300 m，每環轉角約L/R=0.005 rad=0.286°；為小角近似。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume ring width 1.5 m and curvature radius 300 m; turn per ring is approximately L/R=0.005 rad=0.286°, a small-angle approximation.
units.verify: 用核准環片幾何模型重算可達轉角，對照實際組環方向、接縫錯台與尾隙；測量和結構工程師檢查累積幾何，任何組環選擇仍由現場核准程序決定，算例不發出拼裝指令。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只求快速回到中心線可能使用過大曲率，造成接縫張開或尾刷偏壓；未記組環方向又使後續竣工線形無法對應到設計的幾何假設。~Recalculate achievable rotation from approved ring geometry and compare orientation, joint offset and tail clearance; survey and structural leads check accumulation, while actual ring selection follows approved site procedures rather than this calculation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Rapid centerline recovery can demand excessive curvature and produce joint opening or seal loading. Missing ring orientation records also prevent the as-built alignment from being reconciled with the assumed geometry.
units.failure: 只求快速回到中心線可能使用過大曲率，造成接縫張開或尾刷偏壓；未記組環方向又使後續竣工線形無法對應到設計的幾何假設。~Rapid centerline recovery can demand excessive curvature and produce joint opening or seal loading. Missing ring orientation records also prevent the as-built alignment from being reconciled with the assumed geometry.
units.misconception: 只要能回到設計中心線，就不必檢查組環曲率與止水限制。~Returning to the design centerline removes the need to check ring curvature and seal limits.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄曲線組環與楔形量的資料來源與適用條件。用核准環片幾何模型重算可達轉角，對照實際組環方向、接縫錯台與尾隙；測量和結構工程師檢查累積幾何，任何組環選擇仍由現場核准程序決定，算例不發出拼裝指令。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for curved ring building and taper. Recalculate achievable rotation from approved ring geometry and compare orientation, joint offset and tail clearance; survey and structural leads check accumulation, while actual ring selection follows approved site procedures rather than this calculation.

units.anchor: 尾隙與機器環片相對位移~Relative machine-ring clearance
units.title: 尾隙與機器環片相對位移~Relative machine-ring clearance
units.mechanism: 刀盤中心在設計線上不代表盾尾與環片同心，機身轉動、環片抬升及變形會改變相對間隙。導航應同時看機器和已裝環的位置，把線形控制與防水、結構介面連起來。 假設機器中心右偏12 mm、環中心右偏5 mm，相對偏心7 mm；不能用12 mm直接當尾隙偏差。 忽略環片浮起會把尾隙變化全歸機器偏航，錯誤修正可能進一步壓傷密封；只看平均中心差又會漏掉橢圓化造成的局部接觸不足。~A cutterhead on alignment does not ensure concentric shield tail and lining. Machine rotation, ring uplift and deformation alter relative clearance, requiring both machine and installed-ring positions to connect guidance with sealing and structural interfaces. Assume machine center 12 mm right and ring center 5 mm right; relative eccentricity is 7 mm, not the full 12 mm machine offset. Ignoring ring uplift attributes every gap change to machine yaw and can worsen seal loading through incorrect correction. Mean center difference also misses local contact loss caused by ring ovalization.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設機器中心右偏12 mm、環中心右偏5 mm，相對偏心7 mm；不能用12 mm直接當尾隙偏差。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume machine center 12 mm right and ring center 5 mm right; relative eccentricity is 7 mm, not the full 12 mm machine offset.
units.verify: 同時量測尾隙、機身姿態與最新環片中心，使用同一坐標和時刻比較；將局部最大間隙與核准設備包絡核對，偏差原因由測量、設備和組環負責人共同辨識。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略環片浮起會把尾隙變化全歸機器偏航，錯誤修正可能進一步壓傷密封；只看平均中心差又會漏掉橢圓化造成的局部接觸不足。~Measure clearance, pose and latest ring center at a common time and datum; compare local extreme gaps with the approved equipment envelope and jointly identify causes through survey, equipment and ring-building leads. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring ring uplift attributes every gap change to machine yaw and can worsen seal loading through incorrect correction. Mean center difference also misses local contact loss caused by ring ovalization.
units.failure: 忽略環片浮起會把尾隙變化全歸機器偏航，錯誤修正可能進一步壓傷密封；只看平均中心差又會漏掉橢圓化造成的局部接觸不足。~Ignoring ring uplift attributes every gap change to machine yaw and can worsen seal loading through incorrect correction. Mean center difference also misses local contact loss caused by ring ovalization.
units.misconception: 刀盤在設計線上就代表盾尾與已安裝環片必定同心。~A cutterhead on the design alignment guarantees concentric shield tail and installed rings.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄尾隙與機器環片相對位移的資料來源與適用條件。同時量測尾隙、機身姿態與最新環片中心，使用同一坐標和時刻比較；將局部最大間隙與核准設備包絡核對，偏差原因由測量、設備和組環負責人共同辨識。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for relative machine-ring clearance. Measure clearance, pose and latest ring center at a common time and datum; compare local extreme gaps with the approved equipment envelope and jointly identify causes through survey, equipment and ring-building leads.

units.anchor: 折射環境與品質旗標~Refraction environment and quality flags
units.title: 折射環境與品質旗標~Refraction environment and quality flags
units.mechanism: 隧道熱流和粉塵影響光學測量，量測仍有數字不代表品質正常。環境造成的偏差可能具有方向性，應利用多基準或不同時段交叉檢查，並讓品質旗標隨導航結果一同傳遞。 假設兩次同點讀值相差6 mm、各標準不確定2 mm且獨立，差值標準不確定2.83 mm，差約2.12倍。 熱折射可能使多點一致偏移，濾波後曲線更平順卻更像真實轉向；若品質旗標未傳到決策端，系統會對低可信度數值給出過度確定的判讀。~Heat flow and dust affect optical observations, and a numeric output does not ensure good quality. Directional environmental bias requires multiple references or time-separated checks, with quality flags traveling alongside the navigation result. Two assumed observations differ by 6 mm with independent 2 mm standard uncertainties each; difference uncertainty is 2.83 mm and the discrepancy is about 2.12 times it. Thermal refraction can shift many points together, and filtering makes the false trend resemble genuine steering. Missing quality flags cause the decision layer to treat low-confidence observations as definite positions.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩次同點讀值相差6 mm、各標準不確定2 mm且獨立，差值標準不確定2.83 mm，差約2.12倍。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Two assumed observations differ by 6 mm with independent 2 mm standard uncertainties each; difference uncertainty is 2.83 mm and the discrepancy is about 2.12 times it.
units.verify: 記錄可視、溫度與儀器追蹤狀態，對照穩定參考點及備援量測，判斷共模偏差；不佳品質時由測量主管依核准程序確認資料用途，不能平滑後隱藏環境事件。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：熱折射可能使多點一致偏移，濾波後曲線更平順卻更像真實轉向；若品質旗標未傳到決策端，系統會對低可信度數值給出過度確定的判讀。~Record visibility, temperature and tracking status and compare stable references and backup observations for common bias; survey leads determine acceptable use under approved procedures rather than smoothing environmental events out of the record. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Thermal refraction can shift many points together, and filtering makes the false trend resemble genuine steering. Missing quality flags cause the decision layer to treat low-confidence observations as definite positions.
units.failure: 熱折射可能使多點一致偏移，濾波後曲線更平順卻更像真實轉向；若品質旗標未傳到決策端，系統會對低可信度數值給出過度確定的判讀。~Thermal refraction can shift many points together, and filtering makes the false trend resemble genuine steering. Missing quality flags cause the decision layer to treat low-confidence observations as definite positions.
units.misconception: 把受折射影響的讀值平滑後就能恢復真實機器姿態。~Smoothing refracted observations restores the true machine attitude automatically.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄折射環境與品質旗標的資料來源與適用條件。記錄可視、溫度與儀器追蹤狀態，對照穩定參考點及備援量測，判斷共模偏差；不佳品質時由測量主管依核准程序確認資料用途，不能平滑後隱藏環境事件。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for refraction environment and quality flags. Record visibility, temperature and tracking status and compare stable references and backup observations for common bias; survey leads determine acceptable use under approved procedures rather than smoothing environmental events out of the record.

units.anchor: 資料融合與共同偏差~Data fusion and common bias
units.title: 資料融合與共同偏差~Data fusion and common bias
units.mechanism: 兩個獨立無偏量測可按不確定度加權降低隨機誤差，但共享控制點或相機模型時並不獨立。融合前需列出共同來源，否則算出的精度提升只是重複計算同一證據。 假設獨立標準不確定2與3 mm，融合u=1/√(1/2²+1/3²)=1.664 mm；有共同偏差時不適用。 兩套系統共用錯誤基準可精密地同意一個錯位置，融合後不確定度卻更小；將不同時刻的機位合併又會把真實運動當成量測分歧。~Independent unbiased measurements can be weighted to reduce random error, but shared controls or geometry create dependence. Identify common sources before fusion or the apparent improvement simply counts the same evidence more than once. For assumed independent standard uncertainties 2 and 3 mm, fused u=1/√(1/2²+1/3²)=1.664 mm, inapplicable to a shared bias. Two systems sharing a wrong datum can agree precisely on the wrong position while fusion reports smaller uncertainty. Combining different epochs additionally mistakes genuine machine movement for disagreement between observations.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設獨立標準不確定2與3 mm，融合u=1/√(1/2²+1/3²)=1.664 mm；有共同偏差時不適用。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed independent standard uncertainties 2 and 3 mm, fused u=1/√(1/2²+1/3²)=1.664 mm, inapplicable to a shared bias.
units.verify: 繪製各感測器到坐標基準的依賴圖，檢查共同校準和時間戳，使用未參與融合的控制點驗證；演算法負責人保留權重與異常剔除紀錄，不以多感測器數量宣稱獨立性。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：兩套系統共用錯誤基準可精密地同意一個錯位置，融合後不確定度卻更小；將不同時刻的機位合併又會把真實運動當成量測分歧。~Map dependencies from sensors to datum, checking shared calibration and clocks and validating against unused controls; algorithm owners retain weights and rejection records rather than asserting independence from sensor count alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Two systems sharing a wrong datum can agree precisely on the wrong position while fusion reports smaller uncertainty. Combining different epochs additionally mistakes genuine machine movement for disagreement between observations.
units.failure: 兩套系統共用錯誤基準可精密地同意一個錯位置，融合後不確定度卻更小；將不同時刻的機位合併又會把真實運動當成量測分歧。~Two systems sharing a wrong datum can agree precisely on the wrong position while fusion reports smaller uncertainty. Combining different epochs additionally mistakes genuine machine movement for disagreement between observations.
units.misconception: 兩個共用錯誤基準的感測器融合後可以消除共同偏差。~Fusing two sensors sharing an incorrect datum eliminates their common bias.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄資料融合與共同偏差的資料來源與適用條件。繪製各感測器到坐標基準的依賴圖，檢查共同校準和時間戳，使用未參與融合的控制點驗證；演算法負責人保留權重與異常剔除紀錄，不以多感測器數量宣稱獨立性。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for data fusion and common bias. Map dependencies from sensors to datum, checking shared calibration and clocks and validating against unused controls; algorithm owners retain weights and rejection records rather than asserting independence from sensor count alone.

units.anchor: 貫通檢核與竣工交接~Breakthrough checks and as-built handover
units.title: 貫通檢核與竣工交接~Breakthrough checks and as-built handover
units.mechanism: 導航完整性最後需由獨立控制和竣工幾何驗證，閉合差是整條量測鏈的結果而非某台儀器單獨績效。交接保存設計線、實際環片和機器歷程，讓誤差來源可分辨並供後續淨空與維護使用。 假設獨立零均值橫向隨機誤差的標準不確定度分量10、12、9 mm，RSS=√(100+144+81)=18.03 mm；系統偏差另列。 事後強制平差到零會抹去真實閉合證據，若不保留原始值就無法辨識施工偏差與測量偏差；未交環片實際幾何也會影響營運淨空判斷。~Independent control and as-built geometry ultimately verify navigation. Closure reflects the whole measurement chain, not one instrument's performance. Preserve design, installed rings and machine history for error diagnosis, clearance assessment and future maintenance. Assume standard-uncertainty components of independent zero-mean lateral errors of 10,12 and 9 mm; RSS=√(100+144+81)=18.03 mm, with systematic biases reported separately. Forcing closure to zero afterward erases evidence unless raw observations are retained, preventing separation of construction and survey error. Missing installed-ring geometry also undermines operational clearance assessment after handover.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設獨立零均值橫向隨機誤差的標準不確定度分量10、12、9 mm，RSS=√(100+144+81)=18.03 mm；系統偏差另列。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume standard-uncertainty components of independent zero-mean lateral errors of 10,12 and 9 mm; RSS=√(100+144+81)=18.03 mm, with systematic biases reported separately.
units.verify: 以不共享全部基準的獨立測網檢查貫通與竣工線形，追查閉合差的方向及沿程分布；測量、設計及業主共同確認未解決偏差、資料版本與適用精度，不能只交單一最終座標。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：事後強制平差到零會抹去真實閉合證據，若不保留原始值就無法辨識施工偏差與測量偏差；未交環片實際幾何也會影響營運淨空判斷。~Check breakthrough and as-built alignment with an independently constrained network and examine closure direction and distribution; survey, design and owner leads accept remaining deviations, versions and accuracy limits rather than receiving only one final coordinate. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Forcing closure to zero afterward erases evidence unless raw observations are retained, preventing separation of construction and survey error. Missing installed-ring geometry also undermines operational clearance assessment after handover.
units.failure: 事後強制平差到零會抹去真實閉合證據，若不保留原始值就無法辨識施工偏差與測量偏差；未交環片實際幾何也會影響營運淨空判斷。~Forcing closure to zero afterward erases evidence unless raw observations are retained, preventing separation of construction and survey error. Missing installed-ring geometry also undermines operational clearance assessment after handover.
units.misconception: 事後強制閉合差歸零，就不需要再保存原始貫通誤差。~Forcing closure to zero afterward removes any need to retain the original breakthrough discrepancy.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄貫通檢核與竣工交接的資料來源與適用條件。以不共享全部基準的獨立測網檢查貫通與竣工線形，追查閉合差的方向及沿程分布；測量、設計及業主共同確認未解決偏差、資料版本與適用精度，不能只交單一最終座標。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for breakthrough checks and as-built handover. Check breakthrough and as-built alignment with an independently constrained network and examine closure direction and distribution; survey, design and owner leads accept remaining deviations, versions and accuracy limits rather than receiving only one final coordinate.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設本地點距轉換原點1000 m，尺度錯誤10 ppm產生10 mm位置差；非儀器隨機誤差。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設視距300 m、角度誤差1.5 arcsec，側向尺度300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm；未含設站誤差。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At an assumed distance 1000 m from a transformation origin, a 10 ppm scale error creates 10 mm position error, not random instrument noise. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume sight distance 300 m and angular error 1.5 arcsec; lateral scale is 300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm, excluding station error. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示把坐標基準、機身姿態與環片幾何連成可獨立查核的導航鏈需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why link coordinate datum, machine attitude and ring geometry in an independently checkable navigation chain requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設本地點距轉換原點1000 m，尺度錯誤10 ppm產生10 mm位置差；非儀器隨機誤差。~Teaching quantitative note: At an assumed distance 1000 m from a transformation origin, a 10 ppm scale error creates 10 mm position error, not random instrument noise.

教學量化備忘：假設視距300 m、角度誤差1.5 arcsec，側向尺度300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm；未含設站誤差。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume sight distance 300 m and angular error 1.5 arcsec; lateral scale is 300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm, excluding station error.
教學量化備忘：假設方向偏差0.001 rad，在100 m投影造成約100 mm側移；小角近似e=Lθ。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume direction bias 0.001 rad; projection over 100 m gives approximately 100 mm lateral error through e=Lθ.

教學量化備忘：假設目標距刀盤中心10 m、偏航0.1°，橫向桿臂修正10sin0.1°=17.45 mm；非可忽略常數。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume target-to-cutterhead lever arm 10 m and yaw 0.1°; lateral correction is 10sin0.1°=17.45 mm, not a negligible constant.

教學量化備忘：假設水平前進100 m、縱坡2%，高程變化2 m，斜長√(100²+2²)=100.020 m；里程定義須明示。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume 100 m horizontal advance on a 2% grade; elevation changes 2 m and slope length is 100.020 m, requiring an explicit chainage convention.

教學量化備忘：假設環寬1.5 m、曲率半徑300 m，每環轉角約L/R=0.005 rad=0.286°；為小角近似。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume ring width 1.5 m and curvature radius 300 m; turn per ring is approximately L/R=0.005 rad=0.286°, a small-angle approximation.
